source_columns: CBORNUS, MOMBORN1, DADBORN1, MOMBORN2, DADBORN2, HHMOM1, HHDAD1, HHMOM2, HHDAD2
expression:
local({
  parents <- cbind(
    if_else(HHMOM1 %in% c(1, 2), MOMBORN1, NA_real_),
    if_else(HHDAD1 %in% c(1, 2), DADBORN1, NA_real_),
    if_else(HHMOM2 %in% c(1, 2), MOMBORN2, NA_real_),
    if_else(HHDAD2 %in% c(1, 2), DADBORN2, NA_real_)
  )
  in_us <- rowSums(parents == 1 | parents == 2, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  abroad <- rowSums(parents == 3, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  case_when(
    in_us ~ "Native",
    abroad & CBORNUS %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Second-generation",
    abroad & CBORNUS == 3 ~ "First-generation",
    .default = "Unknown"
  )
})
notes: Parent report of the child's birthplace (CBORNUS, PR1) and the resident parent figures' birthplaces (MOMBORN1, DADBORN1, and MOMBORN2, DADBORN2 for same-sex parents; PS6, PT5), counted only where HHMOM1/HHDAD1/HHMOM2/HHDAD2 mark a parent figure, not a non-parent guardian. A U.S. territory counts as the United States. Native if any parent figure was born in the United States; otherwise the child's birthplace decides; no parent figure in the household (509 rows) = Unknown. Partial: resident parent figures only, so a parent outside the household is never observed.

})
